name: Coordinator decide(create_change) → author the OpenSpec change
description:
The authoring station. When a coordinator loop terminates with decide(action=create_change) — the taxonomy token for 'an intaken issue needs an OpenSpec change authored' — spawn the authoring loop that calls the create_change tool. create_change (already registered) stamps openspec.change.<slug>.* on the RUN entity (resolved from the loop's inherited RunID → agent.run_entity_id metadata) and REPLACES that package atomically; the graph is authoritative and the artifacts hydrate from it.

ROLE = coordinator (design roster: only Sarah/Amelia/Quinn, and Sarah the coordinator OWNS create_change). There is no separate 'author' persona — the authoring loop is a coordinator loop scoped to author. It is NOT a routing turn: tool_choice=function forces the create_change call and tools stays nil (global discovery advertises create_change among the registered tools), so the loop calls create_change and terminates (StopLoop) rather than deciding. It writes openspec.change.* (not coordinator.decision.*), so it triggers no coordinator decision rule — no loop.

run_scope=inherit (NOT new): the run already exists (minted at issue_intake), so the author inherits it and stamps the change onto the SAME run entity. Keeping this inherit (never a second run_scope=new) is what keeps the single-anchor handoff valid and the dual-anchor conformance guard green.

No lineage fence (mirrors semteams create-change/01): a rework coordinator that re-decides create_change SHOULD re-fire this rule to re-author a fresh change (create_change REPLACES the package; the D5/D15#0 re-validate contract is owned by the approval gate, not here).

DEFERRED (real-LLM fidelity): the authoring loop inherits Sarah's routing persona (decision contract), which is inert under the mock and structurally overridden by tool_choice=function here. Before the first real-LLM token, give authoring its own persona fragment (or an author sub-role) so the prompt does not fight the tool gate.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.coordinator
on_enter.prompt:
SEMDEV — author the OpenSpec change for this run.

A coordinator classified this run as needing a spec authored: $entity.triple.coordinator.decision.reason

Turn the issue into a structured OpenSpec change and record it with the create_change tool: a slug, a proposal (intent + scope), one spec delta per affected capability (each ADDED/MODIFIED requirement carries an RFC-2119 'The system SHALL …' statement and at least one Given/When/Then scenario), and the implementation tasks. Emit the change CONTENT only — never a validation outcome (the harness validates). Calling create_change completes your turn.

metadata.station: create_change — author the change onto the run
metadata.run_scope_rationale: inherit, NOT new — the run was minted at issue_intake; the author stamps openspec.change.* on the same run entity. Never a second run_scope=new (keeps the dual-anchor guard green).
metadata.role_rationale: coordinator (Sarah owns create_change; 3-role roster has no separate author). tool_choice=function + nil tools (global discovery) forces the create_change call, so this is an authoring turn, not a routing turn.
metadata.deferred_authoring_persona: the authoring loop inherits Sarah's routing persona; inert under the mock and overridden by tool_choice=function. Give authoring its own persona/sub-role before the first real-LLM token.
